name: default-cpra
about: The default policy, reading CPRA (set by `kx cpra` from NMDP haplotype frequencies) instead of pool PRA for the tie-break and the success model.

tie_break.note: assumption: this project's choice; wait_days divided by the longest wait in the pool

success.about: Chance that one planned transplant goes ahead, by the recipient's pool PRA. Used only by --objective expected and kx simulate.
success.source: Dickerson, Procaccia and Sandholm (2019), Failure-Aware Kidney Exchange, Management Science 65(4), section 8.2, https://par.nsf.gov/servlets/purl/10120603, reporting the crossmatch failure rates of Ashlagi et al. (2011) and the 0.08 exogenous failure rate the authors use.
success.assumption: These rates were reported for clinical CPRA; this policy feeds them the CPRA KidneyLoop computes from one NMDP population, which leaves out DQ and DP and ignores alleles without a single serologic antigen.
